      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # gh-1655: same NDK pre-install as ci.yml build-android — the
      # flavor matrix's Gradle configuration auto-installs the
      # Flutter-pinned NDK mid-build with no retry; one truncated
      # download reds the leg. Bounded-retry pre-install instead.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-store-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK")
          echo "store APK size: $SIZE bytes"
          # UT-CI-1: track the store APK size delta against the previous
          # release's app-store-release.apk asset. Threshold policy: FAIL
          # the job when the APK grows more than +10% release-over-release
          # (engine/asset bloat must be a conscious, changelogged
          # decision). The enforcement guard stays commented out until the
          # first flavor release exists to diff against — flip it on then.
          PREV_SIZE=$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases?per_page=20" \
            --jq '[.[].assets[] | select(.name == "app-store-release.apk")][0].size // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
          if [ -n "$PREV_SIZE" ]; then
            DELTA=$(python3 -c "print(f'{($SIZE - $PREV_SIZE) / $PREV_SIZE * 100:.1f}')")
            echo "Previous release store APK: $PREV_SIZE bytes — delta: ${DELTA}%"
            {
              echo '### Store APK size (UT-CI-1)'
              echo "- this release: $SIZE bytes"
              echo "- previous release: $PREV_SIZE bytes"
              echo "- delta: ${DELTA}% (fail threshold: +10%)"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "No previous release store APK found — baseline recorded (this run: $SIZE bytes)."
          fi
          # UT-CI-1 enforcement (enable once a baseline exists):
          # if [ -n "$DELTA" ] && python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(0 if float('$DELTA') > 10.0 else 1)"; then
          #   echo "::error::store APK grew ${DELTA}% vs the previous release (UT-CI-1 threshold +10%)"
          #   exit 1
          # fi

      - name: Upload APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}
          path: flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-${{ matrix.flavor }}-release.apk
          retention-days: 14

  test-android-emulator:
    # Issue #622 (card DoD): emulator CI job shape for the six mobile
    # channel integration tests (flutter_app/test/integration/
    # mobile_channel_it.dart, tagged `integration`):
    #   IT-flavor-1  — release-manifest audit per flavor
    #   IT-floor-1   — mobile.* availability per tier (issue #19 floor)
    #   IT-observe-1 — hierarchy + screenshot over the channel
    #   IT-gesture-1 — tap / swipe / text injection
    #   IT-shell-1   — Shizuku round-trip (god + opt-in bridge)
    #   IT-consent-1 — consent flow + one-tap disable
    # DISABLED with `if: false` until an emulator runner is provisioned —
    # the hosted pool does not guarantee KVM and a red matrix would gate
    # every release. When provisioned: add
    # `needs: [version, build-android-apks]`, flip the `if` below to
    # `needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'`, add a
    # download-artifact step for `android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}` before
    # the emulator boot, and the job goes green as-is. The same ONE-var
    # rule applies: FLAVOR drives --flavor and FA_FLAVOR.
    name: Android emulator ITs (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: false
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Boot emulator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -e /dev/kvm || { echo "::error::/dev/kvm missing — the provisioned runner must expose KVM"; exit 1; }
          echo no | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd \
            -n fa-it --package "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" --device pixel_5
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd fa-it \
            -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot -accel on &
          adb wait-for-device
          until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Emulator booted"

      - name: Install flavor APK
        run: adb install -r "flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-$FLAVOR-release.apk"

      - name: Run mobile channel IT suite
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test test/integration/mobile_channel_it.dart --tags integration

  build-ios:
    name: Build iOS IPA
    needs: version
    # gh-1906: route to the shared `macos-m5` POOL. The gh-1692 pin of the
    # ONE known-good box (`fa-m5-1` runner-name label) is dead — no m5
    # runner carries a runner-name label anymore, so a set containing one
    # matched ZERO runners and both iOS legs queued forever (live
    # 2026-10-26, blocked v1.0.648 TestFlight). The gh-1692 fa-m5-2
    # signing-env concern is retired: fa-m5-2/fa-m5-3 signed desktop green.
    # The generic [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64] list stays banned (gh-1600
    # F-A: it also matches the Linux box) — see
    # test/workflow_selfhosted_legs_test.dart, which audits this exact
    # label set and bans `fa-m5-*` name labels repo-wide.
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macos-m5]
    # Issue #344: a wedged self-hosted worker (lost completion report)
    # otherwise holds the slot AND the in_progress status until the 300m
    # daily-publish watcher times out; a job-level timeout lets GitHub
    # fail the run server-side and unblock the pool + watchers.
    timeout-minutes: 90
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Update local git mirror
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$MIRROR")"
          # gh-1644: shared resilient updater — fetch retries + blobless
          # recreate with partial-dir cleanup (was single-shot; run
          # 38855793382 died exit 128 on a mid-clone network drop).
          # gh-1665 review: first step of the job, before any checkout —
          # the workspace may hold a pre-merge tree, so bootstrap the
          # script from the commit-pinned raw URL (mirror copy as the
          # no-network fallback), never from $GITHUB_WORKSPACE.
          SCRIPT="$RUNNER_TEMP/update_git_mirror.sh"
          RAW="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/${{ github.sha }}/scripts/update_git_mirror.sh"
          if ! curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 "$RAW" -o "$SCRIPT" \
             || [ ! -s "$SCRIPT" ]; then
            echo "raw bootstrap failed — syncing the mirror and falling back to its copy" >&2
            # gh-1665 review (returned IMPORTANT): in the one-run-wide
            # first-post-merge window the persistent mirror is still a
            # PRE-MERGE tree. Cheap single-shot ensure (bounded resilience
            # stays owned by $SCRIPT below) so the extraction that follows
            # succeeds on any runner that can reach github.com at all —
            # raw.githubusercontent.com being down degrades to the
            # fallback instead of a red leg.
            if [ -d "$MIRROR" ] && git -C "$MIRROR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              git -C "$MIRROR" fetch origin || true
            else
              rm -rf "$MIRROR"
              git clone --mirror https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR" || true
            fi
            BRANCH="$(git --git-dir="$MIRROR" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)"
            git --git-dir="$MIRROR" show "$BRANCH:scripts/update_git_mirror.sh" > "$SCRIPT" \
              || { echo "::error::could not bootstrap update_git_mirror.sh (raw URL unreachable and mirror lacks the script)" >&2; exit 1; }
          fi
          bash "$SCRIPT" \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR"

      # gh-1600 AC2: the workspace on this persistent box is SHARED across
      # workflow runs — the old bare workspace rm -rf failed the checkout on
      # stale unremovable bench leftovers
      # (jobs/fa-2.1-docker-cpu-14/, docker-held trial mounts). Log-and-prune:
      # remove what is removable, move a still-blocked remainder into
      # RUNNER_TEMP, and clone around a surviving mount stub — a stale
      # unremovable path can never fail the checkout. INLINE (not a composite
      # action) on purpose: local `uses: ./...` actions resolve against
      # $GITHUB_WORKSPACE at step time, and on this box the workspace is the
      # PREVIOUS run's tree — the action file would be missing (first run) or
      # stale, since this step IS the checkout.
      - name: Checkout repository from local mirror
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          cd /tmp
          echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          echo "MIRROR=$MIRROR"

          if ! rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE not fully removable — stale paths held by another process (gh-1600); pruning what is removable"
            rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" || true
          fi
          if [ -d "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            # gh-1600 rework (review thread): best-effort prune of previous
            # sidecars BEFORE creating a new one — the containers that held
            # them may have died since, so the retry often succeeds. On
            # this persistent box the runner's own _temp cleanup cannot
            # remove mount-held content either; without the prune every
            # degraded checkout would leave another timestamped dir behind
            # (unbounded growth until manual cleanup).
            rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}"/stale-workspace-* 2>/dev/null || true
            STALE="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/stale-workspace-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
            echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE still non-empty after prune — moving the remainder to $STALE (gh-1600)"
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "$STALE")" 2>/dev/null || true
            if ! mv "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$STALE" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE could not be moved aside either — cloning around the stub (gh-1600)"
            fi
          fi
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          CLONE_TARGET="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          if [ -n "$(ls -A "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            # A mount-point stub survived the prune AND the move-aside (a
            # live bind mount). git clone refuses a non-empty target — build
            # the checkout in a sibling and move it in around the stub. A
            # bench leftover path (e.g. jobs/<run-id>/) is not a repo path;
            # if one ever collides, the move below skips it with a note.
            CLONE_TARGET="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE.checkout"
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
          fi
          # gh-1692 AC3: the depth-1 clone pulls tip blobs from origin over
          # the runner's flaky link — the 10-16 submit leg died on "2876
          # bytes of body are still expected" (exit 128) with NO retry and
          # cost a whole TestFlight day. Bounded retry; a failed attempt
          # leaves a partial dir at $CLONE_TARGET which git refuses to
          # clone into, so it is removed before the next attempt.
          CLONE_RETRIES=3
          for attempt in $(seq 1 "$CLONE_RETRIES"); do
            if git clone --reference "$MIRROR" --depth=1 \
              https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$CLONE_TARGET"; then
              break
            fi
            echo "git clone attempt ${attempt}/${CLONE_RETRIES} failed" >&2
            if [ "$attempt" -eq "$CLONE_RETRIES" ]; then
              echo "::error::git clone from origin failed after ${CLONE_RETRIES} attempts (gh-1692 AC3)" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
            sleep 10
          done
          if [ "$CLONE_TARGET" != "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ]; then
            while IFS= read -r entry; do
              name="$(basename "$entry")"
              if [ -e "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$name" ]; then
                # gh-1600 rework (review thread): fresh content must win —
                # park the stale stub in the same $STALE sidecar and move
                # the fresh entry in. The old path skipped the fresh entry
                # (warning-only) and the trailing rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
                # then DELETED it, silently keeping the stale leftover at
                # that repo path. Skip-with-warning remains only as the
                # last-resort fallback when even parking the stub fails.
                STALE_DIR="${STALE:-${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/stale-workspace-sidecar}"
                if mkdir -p "$STALE_DIR" 2>/dev/null && mv "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$name" "$STALE_DIR/" 2>/dev/null; then
                  mv "$entry" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/"
                else
                  echo "::warning::stub collision on '$name' — left in $CLONE_TARGET (gh-1600)"
                fi
              else
                mv "$entry" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/"
              fi
            done < <(find "$CLONE_TARGET" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
          fi
          echo "Checked out: $(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" log -1 --oneline)"

      # Persistent pinned SDK (issue #354): subosito/flutter-action with
      # cache: true on this PERSISTENT runner cost 5m39s setup (untar ~1GB
      # archive) + 8m47s POST (re-tar the whole SDK) per job — 14.5 of
      # 19.7 min around a 4-min build (run 34815041052). The composite
      # action keeps the SDK at ~/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk with a
      # .fah-version marker: subsecond reuse when the pin is unchanged,
      # exactly one download per pin bump, no cache POST step at all.
      # EXACT patch pin (gh-1826; #1431 discipline — the same 3.47.7 the
      # desktop lane pins): a wildcard spec (3.47.x) re-resolves a freshly
      # released patch the fa-m5 runners have not cached — run 40066130883
      # (2026-10-24) resolved 3.47.x to 3.47.8 and the TestFlight leg died
      # downloading the 2.27 GB SDK inside the bounded curl budget
      # (600s/attempt, 900s total) with 1.48 GB received. 3.47.7 already
      # sits in the persistent slot on every fa-m5 runner (zero download).
      # The runner's hardcoded $HOME/.local/flutter is a stale 3.44.4,
      # below the repo floor >=3.47.0 (daily-publish #260). Bump the pin
      # consciously, matching the desktop lane, in the same PR as any
      # floor reseed.
      - name: Setup Flutter (self-hosted)
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-flutter-selfhosted
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'

      - name: Setup environment (self-hosted)
        run: |
          echo "/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          echo "/opt/homebrew/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      # gh-1692 AC2: the iOS lane pins xcbeautify as the xcodebuild
      # formatter (xcpretty "can result in missing some build errors" —
      # the 10-17/10-18 archive failures printed NO error line). Homebrew
      # keeps it a one-time install on this persistent runner; the step
      # verifies the binary so a missing formatter can never silently
      # re-introduce the xcpretty class.
      - name: Install xcbeautify (xcodebuild formatter, gh-1692)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if command -v xcbeautify >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "xcbeautify already installed: $(xcbeautify --version)"

            brew install xcbeautify
          fi
          xcbeautify --version

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # gh-798 AC1/AC2: fail FAST before any build minute is spent when the
      # version about to be stamped is not above ASC's approved floor
      # (#785's class: altool 90062 at the END of the build). Reads the
      # SAME version source the build lane stamps (BUILD_NAME of the
      # version job); the lane skips named without ASC secrets (the upload
      # leg skips too) and fails closed if ASC is unreachable (E1, one
      # retry). The AC4 marker line lands in the leg log either way.
      - name: Assert TestFlight version floor
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bundle install
          bundle exec fastlane ios assert_version_floor

      # Issue #726 (run 35491603044): pub has no retry for its git-dep
      # mirror clones — one flaky TCP connect to github.com:443 ("Failed
      # to connect ... after 11155 ms") failed the whole leg with no
      # retry. The bounded retry + deterministic-skew fail-fast now lives
      # in the shared composite action every enforce-lockfile pub get in
      # the repo rides (gh-1310; pinned by test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_
      # test.dart).
      - name: Install Flutter dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # #1331 size diet: js_widget_runtime declares `test/assets/` as a
      # package asset DIRECTORY, so its 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture
      # rides every app bundle. Nothing in the app references it (the #1227
      # mac pass verified by grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib and
      # the bundled JS apps — only the package's own tests load it, and
      # those live in the package repo). Removing the file is safe: the
      # pubspec declares the directory, not individual files.
      - name: Prune never-loaded package test fixture (#1331)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # NOTE: no percent-decoding of the file: URI — pub-cache paths on
          # this runner carry no URI escapes; add unquoting if that changes.
          JS_WR=$(python3 -c '
            import json, pathlib
            cfg = json.loads(pathlib.Path("flutter_app/.dart_tool/package_config.json").read_text())
            p = next((q for q in cfg["packages"] if q["name"] == "js_widget_runtime"), None)
            print(p["rootUri"] if p else "")
          ')
          if [ -z "$JS_WR" ]; then
            echo "::warning::js_widget_runtime not in package_config.json — no fixture to prune, skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          case "$JS_WR" in
            file://*) JS_WR=${JS_WR#file://} ;;
          esac
          case "$JS_WR" in
            /*) ;;
            *) JS_WR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$JS_WR" ;;
          esac
          GLB="$JS_WR/test/assets/coach_anny.glb"
          if [ -f "$GLB" ]; then
            rm -f "$GLB"
            echo "pruned coach_anny.glb (5.6 MB never-loaded test fixture, #1331) from $JS_WR"
          else
            echo "coach_anny.glb already absent — nothing to prune"
          fi

      # The workspace is re-cloned every run, which wipes Pods/ and forces a
      # full pod install. Cache it keyed by the lockfile; $HOME-level caches
      # (pub-cache, CocoaPods download cache, Ruby gems, Flutter SDK) already
      # persist on the self-hosted runner.
      # v2: bust the cache — the Podfile.lock was stale (cupertino_http added
      # in 4bcac41 but the lockfile wasn't regenerated), so cached Pods were
      # missing the plugin's native code entirely. The build step's
      # `flutter build ios` runs `pod install` which regenerates the lockfile
      # with all registered plugins.
      - name: Cache CocoaPods (iOS)
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: flutter_app/ios/Pods
          key: ios-pods-v2-${{ hashFiles('flutter_app/ios/Podfile.lock') }}

      - name: Restore vendored WasmRun iOS framework
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The prebuilt XCFramework is excluded from git. Prefer the local
          # working copy on this self-hosted runner; fall back to the upstream
          # release asset if the local copy is unavailable.
          LOCAL_SRC="/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/flutter_agent/vendor/wasm_run_flutter/ios/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework"
          DEST="vendor/wasm_run_flutter/ios/Frameworks"
          rm -rf "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework"
          mkdir -p "$DEST"
          if [ -d "$LOCAL_SRC" ]; then
            echo "Using local framework: $LOCAL_SRC"

# Manual App Store review submission (issue #239 Track 2): submits the iOS
# and/or macOS build of an already-processed TestFlight version straight to
# App Store review. Nothing here builds or uploads a binary — the
# `submit_for_review` lanes pre-flight against App Store Connect and fail
# BEFORE any mutation:
#   - the version must exist (create it via store-metadata.yml first)
#   - a processed TestFlight build must exist for the version
#   - a version already in review = green no-op notice (idempotent re-run)
# `confirm` must repeat `version` exactly (fat-finger guard on an
# irreversible-ish action).
#
# Release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click (owner decision for the
# first month): flipping to automatic release is a one-line repo variable,
# APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE=true (E5).
#
# Secrets: only the existing APP_STORE_CONNECT_* — no new credentials.

name: App Store review submission

run-name: "App Store review (${{ inputs.platforms }}): ${{ inputs.version }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App version to submit (must match a processed TestFlight build, e.g. 1.2.3)'
        required: true
        type: string
      platforms:
        description: 'Platforms to submit'
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - ios
          - macos
          - both
      confirm:
        description: 'Type the version string again to confirm'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  guard:
    name: Fat-finger guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Confirm must repeat the version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.confirm }}" != "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::confirm ('${{ inputs.confirm }}') does not equal version ('${{ inputs.version }}') — aborting before any mutation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Confirmed: submitting version ${{ inputs.version }} (${{ inputs.platforms }}) for App Store review"

  ios:
    name: Submit iOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'ios' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@de492cf36cbab201753d720ce4f4e336cd688c94 # v1.328.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane ios submit_for_review

  macos:
    name: Submit macOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'macos' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@de492cf36cbab201753d720ce4f4e336cd688c94 # v1.328.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane mac submit_for_review
